name: Entain Plc
summary: Entain Plc operates as a sports-betting and gaming company in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Italy, rest of Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and internationally. It provides online and multi-channel betting under the Ladbrokes name; street and online betting under the Coral name; online sports betting, casino, and gaming under the Eurobet name; scores, sports information, editorial and social content, and sports focused free-to play games under the 365Scores name; sports betting and gaming operator under the SuperSport and BetCity names; online betting under the bwin name; and sports betting, poker, and casino games under the Crystalbet name.
